Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Voltaire (author, Wikidata Q9068), died 1778; Adrien Jean Quentin Beuchot (editor, Wikidata Q2825095), died 1851. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Voltaire, 1694-1778; Beuchot, A. J. Q. (Adrien Jean Quentin), 1777-1851 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Oeuvres complètes de Voltaire. Tome premier soixantieme Siècles de Louis 14. et de Louis 15. Tome 2, chez Carez, Thomine et Fortic, libraires, rue St. André-Des-Arcs, 1820, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_PT72Hi3NdnQC. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 71%, 60%, 53% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Adrien Jean Quentin Beuchot, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
